# Graphics/Graphics

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [GraphicsContext.h](GraphicsContext.h): declares `Context`
- [GraphicsContextImpl.h](GraphicsContextImpl.h): Composites view and its descendants into an off-screen bitmap sized bounds * scale and returns it as a straight-alpha Image: each view's paint() chrome, then its attached shape/text layers, its GPU (Metal) content, then its child views. (declares `renderLayerToImage`, `MacOSContext`)
- [Keyboard-MacOS.h](Keyboard-MacOS.h): declares `modifierKeysFromEvent`, `keyEventFrom`
- [Keyboard.h](Keyboard.h): declares `ModifierKeys`, `KeyEventType`, `KeyEvent`, `Key`, `Keyboard`
- [SharedDevices.h](SharedDevices.h): Releases the process-wide devices drawing brings up on first use - on Windows the D3D11, Direct2D and DirectComposition devices behind every view and the D3D12 device behind GPU::Device::shared() - each to be built again by its next use. (declares `releaseSharedDevices`)
